sections.title: Capacity Estimation Cheat Sheet
sections.body:
A visual cheat sheet for quick review before interviews!

### Power of 2
```
2^10 = 1 KB    = 1,024 bytes
2^20 = 1 MB    = 1,048,576 bytes
2^30 = 1 GB    = 1,073,741,824 bytes
2^40 = 1 TB    = 1,099,511,627,776 bytes
2^50 = 1 PB
```

### Time Conversions
```
1 day = 86,400 seconds
1 million seconds ≈ 11.5 days
1 billion seconds ≈ 31.7 years
```

### QPS Calculation
```python
# Daily Active Users to QPS
DAU = 100,000,000  # 100M users
actions_per_day = 10
total_daily_requests = DAU * actions_per_day

avg_QPS = total_daily_requests / 86,400
peak_QPS = avg_QPS * 2  # Assume 2x peak traffic

# Example:
# 100M users × 10 actions = 1B requests/day
# QPS = 1,000,000,000 / 86,400 ≈ 11,574 QPS
# Peak = 23,148 QPS
```

### Storage Estimation
```python
# Users with photos
users = 1,000,000,000  # 1 billion
photos_per_user = 10
avg_photo_size = 2 MB

total_storage = users × photos_per_user × avg_photo_size
# = 1B × 10 × 2MB = 20,000,000 GB = 20 PB

# With replication (3x)
with_replication = 20 PB × 3 = 60 PB
```

### Bandwidth Estimation
```python
# QPS to Bandwidth
QPS = 10,000
avg_response_size = 100 KB

bandwidth = QPS × avg_response_size
# = 10,000 × 100 KB = 1,000,000 KB/s = 1 GB/s
# In Gbps = 1 GB/s × 8 = 8 Gbps
```

sections.title: CAP Theorem
sections.body:
```
You can only pick 2 out of 3:

        Consistency
           /  \
          /    \
         /      \
        /   CA   \
       /          \
   CP /_____⚠️_____\ AP
     /              \
Partition          Availability
Tolerance

CP Systems: MongoDB, HBase, Redis
AP Systems: Cassandra, DynamoDB, Riak
CA Systems: PostgreSQL, MySQL (single node)
```

sections.title: Latency Numbers
sections.body:
```
┌────────────────────────────────────┬─────────────┐
│ Operation                          │ Latency     │
├────────────────────────────────────┼─────────────┤
│ L1 cache reference                 │ 0.5 ns      │
│ L2 cache reference                 │ 7 ns        │
│ RAM reference                      │ 100 ns      │
│ SSD random read                    │ 150 μs      │
│ Read 1 MB sequentially from SSD    │ 1 ms        │
│ Disk seek                          │ 10 ms       │
│ Read 1 MB from disk                │ 20 ms       │
│ Round trip within datacenter       │ 500 μs      │
│ Round trip CA to Netherlands       │ 150 ms      │
└────────────────────────────────────┴─────────────┘

Key Insight:
• Memory is 10,000x faster than disk
• Network within datacenter is fast
• Network across continents is SLOW
```

sections.title: Scaling Strategies
sections.body:
### Vertical Scaling (Scale Up)
```
Before:          After:
┌──────┐        ┌──────┐
│ 4CPU │   →    │16CPU │
│ 8GB  │        │64GB  │
└──────┘        └──────┘

✅ Simple
❌ Expensive
❌ Single point of failure
❌ Hardware limits
```

### Horizontal Scaling (Scale Out)
```
Before:          After:
┌──────┐        ┌──────┬──────┬──────┐
│Server│   →    │Srv 1 │Srv 2 │Srv 3 │
└──────┘        └──────┴──────┴──────┘

✅ Cost effective
✅ High availability
✅ No limits
❌ More complex
```

sections.title: Database Scaling Patterns
sections.body:
### Master-Slave Replication
```
       ┌────────┐
       │ Master │ ← Writes
       └───┬────┘
           │ Replicate
    ┌──────┼──────┐
    │      │      │
┌───▼──┐ ┌─▼──┐ ┌─▼──┐
│Slave │ │Slave│ │Slave│ ← Reads
└──────┘ └────┘ └────┘

✅ Read scaling
✅ High availability
❌ Write bottleneck
❌ Replication lag
```

### Database Sharding
```
Users 1-1M    → Shard 1
Users 1M-2M   → Shard 2
Users 2M-3M   → Shard 3

✅ Write scaling
✅ Huge capacity
❌ Complex queries
❌ Rebalancing hard
```

sections.title: Cache Eviction Policies
sections.body:
```
┌────────┬───────────────────────────────────┐
│ LRU    │ Remove Least Recently Used        │
│        │ Best for: General purpose         │
├────────┼───────────────────────────────────┤
│ LFU    │ Remove Least Frequently Used      │
│        │ Best for: Popular content         │
├────────┼───────────────────────────────────┤
│ FIFO   │ Remove First In First Out         │
│        │ Best for: Simple queue-like       │
├────────┼───────────────────────────────────┤
│ TTL    │ Remove after Time To Live         │
│        │ Best for: Session data            │
└────────┴───────────────────────────────────┘
```

sections.title: Interview Problem-Solving Template
sections.body:
```
1. REQUIREMENTS (5 min)
   ✓ Clarify functional requirements
   ✓ Clarify non-functional requirements
   ✓ Understand scale and constraints

2. ESTIMATION (5 min)
   ✓ Calculate QPS
   ✓ Estimate storage
   ✓ Estimate bandwidth

3. HIGH-LEVEL DESIGN (10 min)
   ✓ Draw basic architecture
   ✓ Identify major components
   ✓ Explain data flow

4. DEEP DIVE (15 min)
   ✓ Database schema
   ✓ API design
   ✓ Scaling strategies
   ✓ Handle bottlenecks

5. WRAP UP (5 min)
   ✓ Discuss trade-offs
   ✓ Monitoring & metrics
   ✓ Future improvements
```

sections.title: Key Takeaways
sections.body:
### Do's ✅
- Always clarify requirements
- Start simple, then scale
- Use numbers to back decisions
- Think about failure scenarios
- Discuss trade-offs explicitly
- Draw clear diagrams

### Don'ts ❌
- Don't over-engineer
- Don't ignore constraints
- Don't skip calculations
- Don't memorize solutions
- Don't forget to communicate
